````text
# #2022: Patch: the rank reads fetch only the players they show and the Mythic rows, not the whole season's ladder
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
The server does three things often: open a match screen, open your rank, and file the statistics of every finished game. Each time, it reads the ranked standing of every player in the current season, joins each to their profile and rating, and then keeps one or two rows plus the top-tier players.

As the ladder fills over a season, that work grows with it, on some of the most frequent reads the server makes. Once this is built, those reads fetch only the players they need and the top-tier rows a leaderboard position comes from. Nothing on screen changes; the server does far less work per match as the season grows.

## Why
- `crates/server/src/db/pg.rs:5784-5797` `ranked_standings` filters only `where r.season_id = $1::text`. It joins `profiles` and `bot_ratings`, then turns every row into a `serde_json::Value` and back (`:5800-5810`).
- Three frequent callers each use one or two rows of it, plus the Jlorious order:
  - `api/ranked.rs:726` `own_rank` (GET /api/ranked);
  - `api/ranked.rs:922` `match_ranks` (GET /api/matches/:id/ranks, which the match screens read);
  - `api/ranked.rs:950` `ladder_tiers`, called for the play telemetry of every match (`actor/match_actor.rs:702`, then `actor/telemetry.rs:362`).
- What they actually need:
  - `rank_in` (`api/ranked.rs:660`) finds one profile's row;
  - `jlorious_order` (`ranked/ladder.rs:386-406`) keeps only Mythic-tier, non-bot rows, sorted by rating then id, `take(JLORIOUS_SIZE)`.
- `migrations/0022_ranked_ladder.sql` gives `season_ranks` only its primary key `(season_id, profile_id)` and a profile index, so nothing serves a read by tier.
- #1996 made the queue's waiting-room readout read through indexes instead of every game ever played. This is the same kind of fix for the rank reads.

## Proposal
- Add a store method returning a season's rows for the given profile ids, plus every row at or above the Mythic floor, with the same rating join and `bot` flag (R640000).
  - The floor is `tier_bottom(MYTHIC)` from `ranked/ladder.rs`, passed as a bind, never restated in SQL.
  - `jlorious_order` and `rank_in` stay in Rust unchanged, so sorting, ties and NaN ratings behave exactly as today.
- Use it in `own_rank`, `match_ranks` and `ladder_tiers`. The rated-game plan (`api/ranked.rs:392`, which needs every rating for percentiles) and the leaderboard (R612 lists everyone) stay on `ranked_standings`.
- Add a migration with an index on `season_ranks (season_id, ladder)`, so the Mythic read is an index range rather than a scan of the season.
- The in-memory fake store implements the same filter.

## Where it lands
- `crates/server/src/db/store.rs`, `pg.rs`, `fake.rs`
- `crates/server/src/api/ranked.rs`
- a new migration under `crates/server/migrations/`
- `crates/server/tests/store/contract.rs` and the ranked API tests
- SPEC §9.12 (ranked): unchanged

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A `tests/store/contract.rs` case, run on both stores. Its season holds ladder bots, rating ties, unplaced players, players below Mythic, and more Mythic rows than `JLORIOUS_SIZE`. With it:
  - `jlorious_order` over the new read equals `jlorious_order` over the full read;
  - `rank_in` is the same for every profile asked for.
- [ ] GET /api/ranked and GET /api/matches/:id/ranks return identical bodies before and after, in the existing API tests.
- [ ] `own_rank`, `match_ranks` and `ladder_tiers` no longer call `ranked_standings`.
- [ ] `sh crates/server/tests/sql/run.sh` and `sh crates/server/tests/db/run.sh` pass with the migration.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-server`, clippy and fmt pass.

## Size and risks
Medium: about 6 files in one crate plus a migration (the migration is what CLAUDE.md rule 11 calls hard).

Risks:
- The Mythic floor must come from the ladder code, or the two can drift.
- A ladder bot's row must keep reading the bot's own rating.
- The migration turns on the db suites in CI.
- The gain grows with the season's size and is small while the ladder is small.

---
Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it.

<!-- jackioh-bot -->

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `claude-8` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40445067636)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

`own_rank` (GET /api/ranked), `match_ranks` (GET /api/matches/:id/ranks) and `ladder_tiers` (each match's play telemetry) read a new store method, `ranked_standings_subset`: one season's rows for the profiles they show, plus every row at or above the Jlorious floor (`tier_bottom(MYTHIC)`, passed as a bind from `ranked/ladder.rs`), with the same rating join and R640000 `bot` flag as `ranked_standings`. Both stores implement it. `jlorious_order` and `rank_in` stay unchanged, so every body is identical. Migration 0064 adds `season_ranks (season_id, ladder)`, so the Mythic read is an index range, and a SQL plan check proves it. The rated-game planner (`plan_ranked_game`), the leaderboard and `bots/pool.rs` keep `ranked_standings`. SPEC §9.12 is unchanged and no ruling is added (R605, R608, R612, R640000, R1436 and R1442 govern; none changes).

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
| --- | --- | --- |

| `crates/server/src/db/pg.rs` | change | `standings_from!` macro, `fn standing_of`, `ranked_standings` uses them, new `ranked_standings_subset` |
| `crates/server/src/db/fake.rs` | change | `fn season_standings` helper, `ranked_standings` uses it, new `ranked_standings_subset` |

Do not touch `plan_ranked_game`, `leaderboard`, `rank_in`, `standings_of` or `jlorious_order`'s body, nor `crates/server/src/bots/pool.rs`, `spec/`, `crates/engine`, `crates/cards`, `crates/ai`, `apps/`, `scripts/`, `.github/`, `bot/`.

## Steps

1. **`ranked/ladder.rs`**, directly above `jlorious_order`'s doc comment:
   ```rust
   /// R608: the lowest ladder position `jlorious_order` reads, Mythic Grape's bottom. A row below it is
   /// never Jlorious, so a read that needs only Jlorious's rows may skip it (#2022).
   pub fn jlorious_floor() -> i32 {
       tier_bottom(MYTHIC)
   }
   ```
   (`tier_index_of(l) == MYTHIC` holds exactly when `l >= tier_bottom(MYTHIC)`, because `tier_index_of` clamps at the top tier.)

2. **`db/store.rs`**, after `ranked_standings`:
   ```rust
   /// `ranked_standings` cut to what a rank read shows (#2022): the season's rows of `profile_ids`, plus
   /// every row whose ladder is at least `min_ladder` (`ladder::jlorious_floor()`: every row Jlorious is
   /// drawn from), each with the player's current rating, in profile-id order. `jlorious_order` over it,
   /// and the rank of any profile asked for, answer as over the whole season.
   pub async fn ranked_standings_subset(
       &mut self,
       season_id: &str,
       profile_ids: &[String],
       min_ladder: i32,
   ) -> StoreResult<Vec<SeasonStanding>> {
       dispatch!(self, ranked_standings_subset(season_id, profile_ids, min_ladder))
   }
   ```

3. **`db/pg.rs`**, at `ranked_standings` (~5865). Define a `macro_rules! standings_from` right above it, in the style of `profile_from!` (~574). It expands to the current select list, `from` and both joins, from `"select r.season_id, …"` through `"… b.bot_id = p.id::text"`. Move the row closure into `fn standing_of(row: &PgRow) -> Result<SeasonStanding, StoreError>` with the same body. `ranked_standings` becomes `sqlx::query(concat!(standings_from!(), " where r.season_id = $1::text order by r.profile_id"))`, then `rows.iter().map(standing_of).collect()`. Then add:
   ```rust
   /// `ranked_standings` cut to `profile_ids`' rows and every row from `min_ladder` up (#2022), joined
   /// and read as it is, so a ladder bot's row reads its own rating (R640000). An id that is no uuid (a
   /// deleted account's empty seat) names no row and is not bound. Migration 0064's
   /// `season_ranks_season_ladder_idx` serves the ladder range (tests/sql CHECK 21).
   pub async fn ranked_standings_subset(
       t: &mut PgTx<'_>,
       season_id: &str,
       profile_ids: &[String],
       min_ladder: i32,
   ) -> Result<Vec<SeasonStanding>, StoreError> {
       let ids: Vec<String> = profile_ids.iter().filter(|id| is_uuid(id)).cloned().collect();
       run_as(t, None).await?;
       let rows = sqlx::query(concat!(
           standings_from!(),
           " where r.season_id = $1::text
               and (r.profile_id = any($2::uuid[]) or r.ladder >= $3::integer)
             order by r.profile_id"
       ))
       .bind(season_id)
       .bind(ids)
       .bind(min_ladder)
       .fetch_all(&mut **t)
       .await
       .map_err(db_error)?;
       rows.iter().map(standing_of).collect()
   }
   ```
   Do not return early on an empty `ids`: the Mythic arm must still answer, and `'{}'::uuid[]` is legal. The `is_uuid` filter copies `presence_last_seen` (~7307). Without it, `match_ranks` on a match with a deleted seat (`""`, pg.rs KNOWN DIVERGENCES) would fail with `invalid input syntax for type uuid`.

4. **`db/fake.rs`**, at `ranked_standings` (~3646). Move everything after its `call(…)?;` into `fn season_standings(tables: &FakeTables, season_id: &str, keep: impl Fn(&SeasonRank) -> bool) -> Vec<SeasonStanding>`, with `keep(row)` as one more `.filter` after the season filter. `ranked_standings` becomes `call(f, "ranked.standings")?; Ok(season_standings(f.tables(), season_id, |_| true))`. Add:
   ```rust
   /// `ranked_standings` cut to `profile_ids`' rows and every row from `min_ladder` up (#2022), as
   /// Postgres's filter reads it.
   pub fn ranked_standings_subset(
       f: &mut FakeTx<'_>,
       season_id: &str,
       profile_ids: &[String],
       min_ladder: i32,
   ) -> Result<Vec<SeasonStanding>, StoreError> {
       call(f, "ranked.standingsSubset")?;
       Ok(season_standings(f.tables(), season_id, |row| {
           profile_ids.contains(&row.profile_id) || row.ladder.is_some_and(|ladder| ladder >= min_ladder)
       }))
   }
   ```

5. **`api/ranked.rs`**: add `jlorious_floor` to the `crate::ranked::ladder::{…}` import. Replace each of the three `ranked_standings` calls. In `own_rank` (~726): `tx.ranked_standings_subset(&season_id, &[profile_id.to_string()], jlorious_floor())`. In `match_ranks` (~921), with the same season argument as today: `&[row.players.0.clone(), row.players.1.clone()]`. In `ladder_tiers` (~949): `&[players.0.clone(), players.1.clone()]`. Put one comment above the first: `// #2022: the rows shown and Mythic Grape's, all that a rank and Jlorious read.`

6. **New migration `crates/server/migrations/0064_season_ranks_ladder_index.sql`**, with LF endings and a header in `0062_queue_readout_indexes.sql`'s style. The header says: Migration 0064, "The rank reads take Mythic Grape's rows through an index (issue #2022)"; `ranked_standings_subset` (src/db/pg.rs) reads a season's asked rows (served by `season_ranks_pkey` / `season_ranks_profile_idx`) plus every row at or above the Jlorious floor; no index led with `ladder`, so that arm read the season whole; the floor is a bind from `ladder::jlorious_floor()`, never written here, so the index is not partial; only an index, no data; built in this file's transaction; apply order 0022 (season_ranks) -> … -> 0063 -> 0064; safe to re-apply. Body:
   ```sql
   create index if not exists season_ranks_season_ladder_idx
     on public.season_ranks (season_id, ladder);
   ```

7. **`db/migrate.rs`**: after the `0063_game_totals.sql` tuple, add `("0064_season_ranks_ladder_index.sql", include_str!("../../migrations/0064_season_ranks_ladder_index.sql")),` formatted like its neighbours.

8. **`tests/store/migrations_pinned.rs`**: run `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server_store migrations_pinned`. The failure prints the exact `("0064_…", "<sum>"),` line. Add it after the 0063 line and re-run to green.

9. **`tests/sql/run.sh`**: header `(0001-0063)` becomes `(0001-0064)`; `--- migrations 0028-0063 ---` becomes `0028-0064`; append `0064_season_ranks_ladder_index` after `0063_game_totals` in the loop list and in the `case " … "` list (keep the trailing space).

10. **`tests/sql/01_schema_invariants.sql`**: before `\echo '=== ALL CHECKS RAN ==='`, add CHECK 21. The SQL below was run on Postgres 16 with every migration applied: it passes with the index and fails without it.
    ```sql
    \echo '=== CHECK 21 (#2022): the rank reads take a season''s asked rows and its Mythic Grape rows, each through an index ==='
    -- own_rank, match_ranks and ladder_tiers (src/api/ranked.rs) read ranked_standings_subset (src/db/pg.rs):
    -- a season's rows for the profiles shown plus every row from the Jlorious floor up (R608), on every
    -- match screen, rank read and match's telemetry. Over 2,000 analysed probe rows with sequential scans
    -- priced out, the Mythic range must be an Index Cond of season_ranks_season_ladder_idx (migration
    -- 0064), never a Filter over the season, and the asked ids an Index Cond. Without 0064 the planner
    -- walks season_ranks_profile_idx whole and filters. pg.rs's query with its binds as literals: 36 is
    -- jlorious_floor(), Mythic Grape's index 4 x RANK_DIVISIONS_PER_TIER 3 x RANK_PIPS_PER_DIVISION 3.
    -- Rolled back, rows and column statistics; ANALYZE's in-place pg_class counts stay, and no later
    -- file plans a query.
    begin;
    insert into public.seasons (id, patch_version, started_at) values ('check-21', 'check-21.0', now());
    insert into auth.users (id, email, email_confirmed_at)
      select gen_random_uuid(), format('check-21-%s@example.test', n), now() from generate_series(1, 2000) as n;
    insert into public.season_ranks (season_id, profile_id, games, wins, losses, draws, ladder, floor,
                                     streak, peak_ladder, peak_jlorious, updated_at)
      select 'check-21', u.id, 10, 5, 5, 0, (row_number() over (order by u.id))::integer % 40, 0, 0,
             null, null, now()
        from auth.users u
       where u.email like 'check-21-%';
    analyze public.season_ranks;
    do $$
    declare
      asked     text;
      probe     text;
      plan_text text := '';
      line      text;
    begin
      select string_agg(profile_id::text, ',') into asked
        from (select profile_id from public.season_ranks where season_id = 'check-21' and ladder < 36
               order by profile_id limit 2) as two;
      probe := format(
        'select r.season_id, r.profile_id, r.games, r.wins, r.losses, r.draws, r.ladder, r.floor,
                r.streak, r.peak_ladder, r.peak_jlorious, r.updated_at,
                coalesce(b.rating, p.rating) as rating, p.kind
           from public.season_ranks r
           join public.profiles p on p.id = r.profile_id
           left join public.bot_ratings b on p.kind = ''bot'' and b.bot_id = p.id::text
          where r.season_id = ''check-21''::text
            and (r.profile_id = any(''{%s}''::uuid[]) or r.ladder >= 36)
          order by r.profile_id', asked);
      perform set_config('enable_seqscan', 'off', true);
      for line in execute 'explain ' || probe loop
        plan_text := plan_text || line || E'\n';
      end loop;
      if plan_text ~ 'Seq Scan on season_ranks\M' then
        raise exception E'FAIL (CHECK 21): the rank read reads season_ranks whole:\n%', plan_text;
      end if;
      if plan_text !~ '\mseason_ranks_season_ladder_idx\M'
         or plan_text !~ 'Index Cond: [^\n]*ladder >= 36'
         or plan_text ~ 'Filter: [^\n]*ladder >= 36' then
        raise exception E'FAIL (CHECK 21): the rank read filters its season for the Mythic rows instead of reading their range through season_ranks_season_ladder_idx:\n%', plan_text;
      end if;
      if plan_text !~ 'Index Cond: [^\n]*profile_id = ANY' then
        raise exception E'FAIL (CHECK 21): the rank read does not take the asked rows through an index:\n%', plan_text;
      end if;
      raise notice 'OK (CHECK 21): the rank read takes its asked rows through an index and its Mythic rows as a range of season_ranks_season_ladder_idx, and reads no season whole';
    end $$;
    rollback;
    ```

11. **`crates/server/README.md`**: after the "Migration 0063 …" paragraph, add one paragraph saying migration 0064 only adds `season_ranks_season_ladder_idx` on `(season_id, ladder)` for `ranked_standings_subset` (#2022), the read of `own_rank`, `match_ranks` and `ladder_tiers`; and that `tests/sql/01_schema_invariants.sql` CHECK 21 plans it with sequential scans off and fails when the Mythic range is filtered rather than read through the index.

12. **Tests** (below), then the checks.

## Tests

- **`crates/server/tests/store/contract.rs`**, in `mod bots`, where `new_bot` lives. The new case is `ranked_standings_subset_answers_jlorious_and_every_asked_rank_as_the_whole_season_does`, listed in that module's `both_stores!`. Imports: add `JLORIOUS_SIZE` to the `config::{…}` import, `SeasonStanding` to the `db::store::{…}` import, and `LADDER_TOP, Standing, jlorious_floor, jlorious_order, visible_rank` to the `ranked::ladder::{…}` import. Seeding:

  - `i32::try_from(JLORIOUS_SIZE).expect("a size") + 1` Mythic persons (`active_profile`), person `n` at ladder `floor + n % (LADDER_TOP - floor + 1)` and rating `1000.0 + f64::from(n / 2)`, so ratings pair up and the 100th and 101st tie at the cut;
  - a Mythic bot (`new_bot(2, now - DAY, 5000.0)`, `bots_create`, row at `LADDER_TOP`);
  - `golden`, a person at `floor - 1` rated 9000.0, who also has a `v0.2` row at `LADDER_TOP`;
  - `rotten`, a person at `Some(0)`;
  - a below-floor bot at `floor - 1`;
  - `raisin`, a person with `ladder: None`;
  - an unplaced bot with `ladder: None`.

  `asked` = golden, raisin, the unplaced bot, the first Mythic person, `id()` (unknown) and `String::new()` (a deleted seat). Let `whole = ranked_standings("v0.1")` and `shown = ranked_standings_subset("v0.1", &asked, floor)`. Assert:
  - `shown` equals `whole` filtered to `asked.contains(id) || ladder >= floor` (same order);
  - `shown.len() < whole.len()`;
  - `jlorious_order` over each (mapped to `Standing`, `!bot` only, as `standings_of`) is equal; it has `JLORIOUS_SIZE` entries and no bot;
  - for every asked id, `visible_rank(row, position + 1)`, computed from each answer as `rank_in` does, is equal.
- **`crates/server/tests/api/ranked.rs`**, in `mod r608_jlorious_through_the_server`, add `r608_the_rank_reads_skip_the_whole_season_and_rank_as_the_leaderboard_does`. Imports: `ladder_tiers` and `match_ranks` (api::ranked), `RankTier` (ladder), `StoreError` (store).

## Risks

- **Floor drift.** The floor has one home, `jlorious_floor()` beside `jlorious_order`, and the ladder test pins the two together. SQL never states it: it is a bind, and the index is not partial.
- **Bot rows (R640000).** The two pg reads share `standings_from!` and `standing_of`, and the fake's share `season_standings`, so a bot's own rating can't drift between them. The contract case checks it.
````
